title: Twisted super Yangians of quasi-split type A
summary: We introduce the twisted super Yangian $Y^{\mathfrak{s}}_{\imath}$ of quasi-split type A in the Drinfeld current presentation for an arbitrary symmetric parity sequence $\mathfrak{s}$. We prove via Gauss decomposition that $Y^{\mathfrak{s}}_{\imath}$ is isomorphic to the special twisted super Yangian $\mathscr{SY}^{\mathfrak{s}}$, a subalgebra of the twisted super Yangian $\mathscr{Y}^{\mathfrak{s}}$ previously defined via the R-matrix presentation.
